decisions.text: When the voltage becomes lower than or equal to 80, the lights controller component shall: Assign off to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.

When the voltage becomes greater than 80 or the flashing mode becomes left flashing, and the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing mode is left flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign left flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: ((the_voltage_antes <= 80 /\ the_voltage > 80) \/ (the_flashing_mode_antes != left_flashing /\ the_flashing_mode = left_flashing)) /\ the_voltage > 80 /\ the_flashing_mode = left_flashing

decisions.text: When the voltage becomes greater than 80 or the flashing mode becomes right flashing, and the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing mode is right flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign right flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: ((the_voltage_antes <= 80 /\ the_voltage > 80) \/ (the_flashing_mode_antes != right_flashing /\ the_flashing_mode = right_flashing)) /\ the_voltage > 80 /\ the_flashing_mode = right_flashing

decisions.text: When the voltage becomes greater than 80 or the flashing mode becomes both flashing, and the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing mode is both flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign both flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: ((((the_voltage_antes <= 80 /\ the_voltage > 80) \/ (the_flashing_mode_antes != both_flashing /\ the_flashing_mode = both_flashing)) /\ (not the_voltage > 80)) /\ the_flashing_mode = both_flashing)

decisions.text: When the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing mode is no flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign off to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.

When the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing timer is greater than or equal to 340, and the indication lights are left flashing or the indication lights are right flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign off to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.

When the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing timer is greater than or equal to 220, and the indication lights are off, and the flashing mode is left flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign left flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_voltage > 80 /\ the_flashing_timer >= 220 /\ the_indication_lights = off /\ the_flashing_mode = left_flashing

decisions.text: When the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing timer is greater than or equal to 220, and the indication lights are off, and the flashing mode is right flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign right flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_voltage > 80 /\ the_flashing_timer >= 220 /\ the_indication_lights = off /\ the_flashing_mode = right_flashing

decisions.text: When the voltage is greater than 80, and the flashing timer is greater than or equal to 220, and the indication lights are off, and the flashing mode is both flashing, the lights controller component shall: Assign both flashing to the indication lights, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_voltage > 80 /\ the_flashing_timer >= 220 /\ the_indication_lights = off /\ the_flashing_mode = both_flashing

decisions.text: When the turn indicator lever changes to the left position, and the emergency flashing is off, the flashing mode component shall: assign left flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_turn_indicator_lever_antes != left /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = left /\ the_emergency_flashing = off

decisions.text: When the turn indicator lever changes to the right position, and the emergency flashing is off, the flashing mode component shall: assign right flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_turn_indicator_lever_antes != right /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = right /\ the_emergency_flashing = off

decisions.text: When the emergency flashing becomes on, the flashing mode component shall: assign both flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.

When the emergency flashing is on, and the emergency flashing was on, and the turn indicator lever changes to the left position, the flashing mode component shall: assign left flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_emergency_flashing = on /\ the_emergency_flashing_antes = on /\ the_turn_indicator_lever_antes != left /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = left

decisions.text: When the emergency flashing is on, and the emergency flashing was on, and the turn indicator lever changes to the right position, the flashing mode component shall: assign right flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_emergency_flashing = on /\ the_emergency_flashing_antes = on /\ the_turn_indicator_lever_antes != right /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = right

decisions.text: When the emergency flashing is on, and the emergency flashing was on, and the turn indicator lever changes to the idle position, and the flashing mode is not both flashing, the flashing mode component shall: assign both flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_emergency_flashing = on /\ the_emergency_flashing_antes = on /\ the_turn_indicator_lever_antes != idle /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = idle /\ the_flashing_mode != both_flashing

decisions.text: When the emergency flashing becomes off, and the turn indicator lever is on the left position, and the turn indicator lever was on the left position, and the flashing mode is not left flashing, the flashing mode component shall: assign left flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_emergency_flashing_antes != off /\ the_emergency_flashing = off /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = left /\ the_turn_indicator_lever_antes = left /\ the_flashing_mode != left_flashing

decisions.text: When the emergency flashing becomes off, and the turn indicator lever is on the right position, and the turn indicator lever was on the right position, and the flashing mode is not right flashing, the flashing mode component shall: assign right flashing to the flashing mode, Reset the flashing timer.
decisions.guard: the_emergency_flashing_antes != off /\ the_emergency_flashing = off /\ the_turn_indicator_lever = right /\ the_turn_indicator_lever_antes = right /\ the_flashing_mode != right_flashing
